name: Cheech & Chong - Singles - Cryo Infused Pre-Roll - Strawberry Stoner (I)
description:
One joint, extra kick. The Cheech & Chong Strawberry Stoner single is a cryo-infused pre-roll packed with quality flower and infused with distillate for a bolder, more potent smoke. No grinding, no rolling, no setup. Just light it and go.

Strawberry Stoner brings a sweet, fruit-forward profile: ripe, juicy strawberry up front with a soft creamy sweetness and a smooth, subtly earthy finish. Blended with an indica terpene profile for a relaxed, mellow feel — easygoing and comfortable, made for evenings and taking it slow.

Why you'll love it:

Cryo-infused pre-roll — quality flower infused with distillate for extra potency
Cryo-infusion process — locks in flavor and delivers a smooth, even burn
Signature Strawberry Stoner flavor — ripe, juicy strawberry with a creamy, earthy finish
Indica effects — relaxing and mellow, ideal for evenings
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in every joint. Cheech & Chong Strawberry Stoner is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
